definition: Clément Farabet is a computer scientist and AI expert known for his contributions to the field of deep learning.
details: He served as a research scientist at the New York University. He serves as the Vice President of Research at Google DeepMind and previously served as the VP of AI Infrastructure at NVIDIA. His scholarly work received over 11,000 citations with an h-index of 21.

explainer.lead: Clement Farabet is a French-American computer scientist.

contributions.name: His thesis focused on real-time image understanding and introduced multi-scale convolutional networks and graph-based techniques for efficient segmentations of class prediction maps.
He continued his collaboration with Yann LeCun, and in 2009, he began working with Yale University's e-Lab, led by Eugenio Culurciello.
Farabet co-founded MadBits, a startup with a focus on web-scale image understanding.

Following this acquisition, Farabet co-founded Twitter Cortex, a team dedicated to building Twitter's deep learning platform for various applications, including recommendations, search, spam detection, and NSFW content and ads.

timeline.what: In 2008, Farabet earned a master's degree in electrical engineering with honors from Institut national des sciences appliquées (INSA) de Lyon, France.
In 2008, after completing his Master's degree, Farabet joined Professor Yann LeCun's laboratory at the Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences at New York University.
In 2013, Farabet received his PhD at Université Paris-Est, co-advised by Professors Laurent Najman and Yann LeCun.
